issues.title: Cloud workspace scaffold & shared types
issues.scope: Create the entire apps/cloud/ skeleton as a SELF-CONTAINED pnpm workspace (own pnpm-workspace.yaml with packages:[] + allowBuilds + devalue/postcss/esbuild overrides copied from site/ precedent, own pnpm-lock.yaml). package.json: private:true; declare ALL runtime deps up front so no Wave-1 issue edits deps (@shortwind/core pinned to published 0.1.0-beta.19, convex, @convex-dev/better-auth, better-auth, @convex-dev/rate-limiter, cac, hono, plus dev: typescript, vitest, @cloudflare/workers-types, wrangler, miniflare/@cloudflare/vitest-pool-workers). tsconfig.json, README.md. Directory stubs: convex/ worker/ cli/ dashboard/ shared/. shared/src/types.ts = ALL plain-data record types + lifecycle enums (active|quarantined|tombstoned) + moderation states. shared/src/scopes.ts = pages:read|pages:write|domains:bind constants. convex/schema.ts SKELETON (empty table defs, filled by CLOUD-10).
issues.acceptance: pnpm install succeeds in apps/cloud/; pnpm -C apps/cloud exec tsc --noEmit passes; shared/src/types.ts exports every record type in the data model; root pnpm-workspace.yaml byte-unchanged; vitest runs (zero tests OK).

issues.title: Device-flow auth client + Better Auth server config
issues.scope: RFC 8628 device authorization grant. cli/src/device-flow.ts (poll loop, short user code, no embedded secret). convex/auth.ts Better Auth config (use @convex-dev/better-auth like nyxe-mail) issuing device-flow + refresh tokens. convex/tokens.ts scoped-token issue/validate/revoke.
issues.acceptance: Unit/golden tests for device-flow state machine (pending->slow_down->authorized->token); token records persist with scopes; revocation flips revokedAt. No live creds (Convex test harness).

issues.title: Phase-0 spike: prove expand() runs in a Worker
issues.scope: Minimal worker/src/expand-edge.ts + worker/wrangler.toml importing @shortwind/core expand() under workerd. Document binary outcome in worker/SPIKE.md (Worker-OK or fall-back-to-Convex-action). Does NOT wire into live serve path.
issues.acceptance: Test invokes expand() inside workerd against a fixed registry, asserts byte-identical to Node result (golden). SPIKE.md records the decision gating CLOUD-22.

issues.title: Shared lockfile-diff + slug + fingerprint port
issues.scope: Pure plain-data helpers in shared/: lockfile-diff.ts (incoming vs stored lockfile -> added/changed/removed families, matching packages/cli/src/lockfile.ts Lockfile/LockEntry shape), slug.ts (derive/validate, collision -> 409 signal), fingerprint.ts (touched-recipe rule body-sha vs header-sha, reuse @shortwind/core computeBodySha/normalizeRecipeBody).
issues.acceptance: Golden fixtures for lockfile-diff; unit tests for slug edge cases; touched-recipe detection matches CLI fingerprint semantics on shared fixture.

issues.title: CLI binary skeleton + cac command wiring
issues.scope: cli/src/bin.ts + cli/src/cli.ts mirroring packages/cli/src/{bin,cli}.ts (cac, error handling). Register STUB commands (login, init-global, publish, update, find, get, delete, visibility, bind-domain) that parse args and call not-yet-implemented handlers. Wire package.json bin field. CLI command word: 'shortwind-cloud' bin, but verbs spoken as e.g. publish.
issues.acceptance: `shortwind-cloud --help` lists all verbs; each stub exits cleanly with 'not implemented'; arg parsing unit-tested. No network.

issues.title: Convex schema (full tables + indexes)
issues.scope: Flesh out convex/schema.ts: accounts, pages, pageVersions, recipeVersions, recipeEditEvents, tokens, auditLog, moderation, idempotencyKeys + indexes (by_slug, by_account, by_customDomain, by_tag). Generate _generated.
issues.acceptance: convex codegen succeeds against local Convex; every shared/src/types.ts record has a matching table; indexes exist for find queries.

issues.title: Global Shortwind home (~/.shortwind/) + login
issues.scope: cli/src/home.ts (resolve active home: local repo recipes/ if present else ~/.shortwind/, PRD 5.2/5.5) + `init --global` + `login` (uses CLOUD-01 device flow) creating ~/.shortwind/ with palette + .shortwind-lock.json (reuse CLOUD-03 lockfile shape) + credentials, bound to logged-in account; login switches active account (gh auth switch semantics; design for multi-account on one machine).
issues.acceptance: Golden test of home resolution precedence; init --global against temp HOME creates expected tree; account-switch updates active binding.

issues.title: Better Auth token validation middleware (server)
issues.scope: convex/lib/auth-guard.ts: validate bearer token, load scopes, enforce pages:read|pages:write|domains:bind. Consumed by every Wave-3 mutation/query.
issues.acceptance: Unit: missing token->401; insufficient scope->403; valid scoped token resolves accountId.

issues.title: Convex expand action (server-side expansion)
issues.scope: convex/expand.ts: action wrapping @shortwind/core expand()+buildRegistry()+parseRecipeFile(). Input HTML/shorthand + resolved recipe set (plain data); output frozen Tailwind HTML + scoped CSS + expandedHash. Default expansion host regardless of CLOUD-02 spike.
issues.acceptance: Golden fixtures (shorthand-in -> frozen-Tailwind-out) byte-identical to core expand; deterministic.

issues.title: R2 artifact store + KV hot cache bindings
issues.scope: worker/src/r2.ts, kv.ts, cache.ts: write/read frozen artifacts to R2, hostname/path->pageId KV cache w/ Convex cold fallback, edge cache invalidation helper. Local miniflare bindings in tests; live creds deferred to CLOUD-30.
issues.acceptance: Integration (miniflare): put->get round-trips artifact; invalidation purges key; cold-miss falls to Convex stub.

issues.title: publish + update (thick path mutation)
issues.scope: convex/pages.ts publish/update implementing PRD 6.2: auth -> lockfile diff -> apply touched recipe bodies + version in recipeVersions + emit recipeEditEvents -> resolve recipe set -> expand action -> write R2 -> version pages/pageVersions -> update stored lockfile -> invalidate edge cache -> return {id,url,version}. Idempotency-keyed; 409-with-existing-id on stable-handle collision. convex/recipes.ts recipe-version write + audit.
issues.acceptance: Integration: create, idempotent re-publish (same key->same id), update (version bump, same URL, prior retained), recipe-edit-rides-up (touched body versioned + audit event), 409 on slug collision. Golden for expand step.

issues.title: find / get query verbs
issues.scope: convex/pages.ts queries: find (q/domain/tag filters, load-bearing PRD 3.1), get (metadata + version list). REST surface in convex/http.ts.
issues.acceptance: Integration: find by q/domain/tag returns expected; empty find -> []; get returns version history. Index-backed.

issues.title: Worker serve router (hot path)
issues.scope: worker/src/router.ts + finalized wrangler.toml: pure router resolve hostname/path -> page record (KV hot, Convex cold), stream R2, edge cache, enforce visibility (public no-auth; private token step). NO expansion, NO DB write on hot path.
issues.acceptance: Integration: public served from R2 via KV hit; private 401 w/o token; tombstoned->410; quarantined->451/404. No Convex write on serve.

issues.title: CLI publish/update/find/get impls + api-client
issues.scope: cli/src/api-client.ts (REST client) + real handlers for publish/update/find/get (replace CLOUD-04 stubs). Publish reads lockfile+fingerprints from active home (CLOUD-11), sends page+lockfile+touched recipe bodies (reuse CLOUD-03 rule). Stateless find-before-publish loop.
issues.acceptance: Integration vs mocked API: publish sends only touched bodies; find->update reuses returned id; no local page-id persistence. Golden for request payload shape.

issues.title: DEPLOY CHECKPOINT: live Convex + Cloudflare wiring
issues.scope: ORCHESTRATOR PAUSES FOR CREDS. Populate live config: convex deploy target (CONVEX_DEPLOYMENT, deploy key), worker/wrangler.toml (account_id, R2 bucket binding, KV namespace id, route), Better Auth secret/issuer URL, apps/cloud/.env.example documenting every var. First e2e deploy of Worker + Convex; smoke-test publish->serve against real R2/KV.
issues.acceptance: Documented env matrix; wrangler deploy + convex deploy succeed; one real page publishes and serves over edge.

issues.title: delete / visibility + tombstone/quarantine lifecycle
issues.scope: convex/pages.ts delete (->tombstone, not hard-delete) + visibility mutation; lifecycle state machine in convex/moderation.ts (active->quarantined->preserved; active->tombstoned). Delete-for-abuse = quarantine to sealed store, distinct from tombstone.
issues.acceptance: Integration: delete tombstones + purges cache (page->410); visibility change updates record + cache; quarantine seals R2 object + flips lifecycle; states mutually exclusive and audited.

issues.title: Abuse intake + kill path + CSAM/NCMEC preservation
issues.scope: PRD 8 must-ship. Reachable abuse-report intake (convex/http.ts route + monitored address); fast global kill (purge edge cache + tombstone + quarantine R2, reuse CLOUD-31); preserve-not-delete sealed store; NCMEC CyberTipline report record (moderation.ncmecReportId, 60-day preservation metadata); notice-and-takedown path.
issues.acceptance: Integration: abuse report creates moderation record; kill op makes page unreachable in one transaction; preserved object retained (not deleted) + sealed; report metadata captured. Invariant test: quarantined object NEVER hard-deleted.

issues.title: Publish-time content classifier + hash-matching + rate limits
issues.scope: PRD 8.2/8.4. Hash-match incoming artifacts vs known-CSAM lists at publish; domain-reputation/phishing-malware checks; per-account rate limits (use @convex-dev/rate-limiter like nyxe-mail/Togethr). Additive hook into CLOUD-23 publish pipeline.
issues.acceptance: Integration/unit: hash-list match blocks publish + opens moderation record; rate-limit trips after threshold; classifier score gate configurable.

issues.title: CLI delete/visibility + SKILL.md + recipe-palette discovery
issues.scope: Real delete/visibility CLI handlers; cloud SKILL.md (reuse @shortwind/core renderSkillMarkdown for palette + prepend cloud verbs); agent discovery surface advertising account current vocabulary (PRD 5.7/7.3 works-today).
issues.acceptance: Golden for SKILL.md output (verbs + palette section); CLI delete/visibility hit right endpoints; palette discovery reflects cloud recipeVersions.

issues.title: Human dashboard (oversight + audit log + recipe-edit visibility)
issues.scope: dashboard/ Convex-reactive UI (TanStack + React, reference nyxe-mail/Togethr) showing pages, versions, audit log, and DISTINCT recipe-edit events ('agent modified @card 0.4.0->0.5.0, affects N pages', PRD 5.4). Operator policy toggles (custom-domain-needs-approval). Read-mostly.
issues.acceptance: Dashboard renders live page/audit/recipe-edit feeds from Convex; policy toggle persists; recipe-edit events shown distinctly. Component tests + 1 integration smoke.

issues.title: bind-domain server (Cloudflare for SaaS, human-gated)
issues.scope: convex/domains.ts: bind custom hostname via Cloudflare for SaaS API (edge-terminated SSL), gated on domains:bind scope + human approval policy. Poll hostname-details endpoint for cert state (webhooks enterprise-only). Handle cert-issuance rate-limit queue/backoff. worker/src/router.ts custom-hostname resolution (additive).
issues.acceptance: Integration (mocked CF SaaS API): bind requires domains:bind; without approval->pending-human; cert state polled to active; rate-limit->queued+retried; domain billing meter incremented.

issues.title: CLI bind-domain + step-up scope grant
issues.scope: Real bind-domain CLI handler; default token lacks domains:bind; trigger human step-up grant (PRD 7.2).
issues.acceptance: Integration: bind w/o scope->step-up prompt; with granted scope->calls server. Golden request payload.

issues.title: Standards discovery endpoints (RFC 9728 / 9727)
issues.scope: PRD 7.3 works-as-agents-catch-up. Serve /.well-known/oauth-authorization-server (RFC 9728) + endpoint catalog (RFC 9727) from Worker/Convex http for zero-setup agent discovery+auth.
issues.acceptance: Golden fixtures for both well-known docs; schema-valid per RFC; point at device-flow + REST verbs.

issues.title: Custom-domain + publish/storage billing meter
issues.scope: PRD 6.4/11 metered billing aligned to publishes, storage, custom domains (not page views). Counters in Convex + dashboard surface. Reference Polar/Stripe in nyxe-mail/Togethr.
issues.acceptance: Integration: publish increments publish meter; bind increments domain meter; storage measured from R2 keys; viral-serve adds zero. Dashboard shows usage.

issues.title: Bundles: linked multi-file deploys, one entry point
issues.scope: PRD 10 Phase 3. Multi-file deploy unit with cross-file link rewriting (link-before-deploy), one entry point. New bundleVersions table + publish-bundle pipeline reusing single-file expand/R2/version machinery.
issues.acceptance: Integration: bundle w/ internal links publishes; links resolve to served siblings; entry point routes; rollback retained. Golden link-rewrite fixtures.

issues.title: Optional: visibility tiers, expiry, project grouping
issues.scope: PRD 10 Phase 3 optional. Expiry timestamps + scheduled tombstone; project grouping field + find filter; extended visibility tiers.
issues.acceptance: Integration: expired page->tombstoned by scheduled job; group filter in find; new tiers enforced at serve.
